jobs.title: Uniskai by Profisea Labs
jobs.description: Uniskai | Profisea Labs Products Uniskai by Profisea Labs Case Studies Pricing Resources Blog Webinar & Events FinOps Hub Company Career Contact Us Sign In Book a Demo Uniskai All your FinOps needs Uniskai enables DevOps and FinOps teams to gain full control over their Cloud spend and reduce costs by up to 75%, seamlessly. The FinOps OS Endless challenges, multiple solutions, one dashboard. Reach your desired FinOps posture, with zero effort. Cost Visibility An intuitive billing dashboard with detailed cost show-back and future cost predictions. Easily monitor and manage your spending across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Ensure your cloud infrastructure remains cost-effective and financially optimized with granular insights and actionable recommendations: Billing Summary Tailored Time Analysis Resource Status Classification Credit Tracking Anticipated Savings Interactive Reports Rightsizing Personalized rightsizing recommendations that optimize cloud cost savings by up to 75%. Select the ideal instance size and type, perfectly aligned with your actual workload demands. Our user-friendly interface offers unmatched command over your cloud expenses: Comprehensive Recommendations Informed Decision-Making Based on Data Flexible Assessment Visible Cost Impact Seamless Integration Efficient Bulk Actions Advanced Filtering Options. Spot Instances Distinctive strategy to transform instances into cost-effective spots. Seamlessly manage your Spot Instances, minimizing downtime through proactive system actions: Smooth Spot Conversion Intelligent Instance Management Comprehensive Instance Suggestions Flexible Instance Reversion Customized Filtering Data-Informed Decision Making. Waste Manager Waste Manager that swiftly identifies unutilized, duplicated, or improperly sized resources and backups. Effortlessly eliminate cloud waste with just a single click, initiating immediate savings: Thorough Detection Automated Cleanup Bulk Actions Detailed Annotations Cloudview Integration. Reserved Instances The ultimate cost-efficient solution for critical applications that require high availability and consistent workloads. Secure your capacity at a discounted rate for a fixed period in the future. Cloud Resource Optimization AWS Reserved Instances Insights (including Standard and Convertible types) Flexible Recommendations Easy Attribute Customization Savings Comparison & Alternative Strategies “Dry Run” Simulations. Cloudsitter An AI-powered feature that delivers ingenious scheduling recommendations based on user behavior patterns. Automate resource hibernation to strategically save on your cloud budget: Automated Scheduling Intuitive User-Friendly Interface Robust Policy Management Instant AI Insights Kubernetes Dashboard Uniskai’s Kubernetes dashboard provides real-time visibility into your clusters, allowing you to monitor CPU, memory, pod, and node performance. It supports rightsizing recommendations, billing information, and shutdown of node/namespaces. Seamlessly integrated with AWS, Azure, and GCP, the dashboard helps optimize resource allocation, manage resources, and reduce costs, ensuring maximum efficiency across all your Kubernetes environments. Uniskai: Seamless Onboarding & Instant Action 1 Account Onboarding 2 Analysis and Visualization 3 1-Click Action Account Onboarding Uniskai seamlessly integrates with all the major cloud providers, starting with AWS, Azure, and GCP. Simply connect your account to Uniskai, and all your information will be synchronized in no time. Analysis and Visualization The Uniskai platform provides an AI-driven FinOps strategy, offering instant, real-time visual representation of your cloud infrastructure, along with security and performance recommendations. 1-Click Action Uniskai empowers you to efficiently manage your cloud infrastructure, reducing waste, optimizing spending, setting hibernation schedules, and activating security and performance alerts – all accomplished with just a single mouse click. Our FinOps Approach: Optimization Layering Leverage multiple optimization solutions and maximize your cloud savings. Uniskai’s advanced Optimization Algorithm analyzes your cloud account and offers the most optimal workflow that includes several optimization layers, to reduce your costs. How does it work? Working with Rightsizing Shifting non mission critical On-demand to Spot Instances Shifting mission-critical On-demand to RIs/SPs 100 On-demand EC2 Instances 80 On-demand EC2 Instances 40 On-demand EC2 Instances 30 On-demand EC2 Instances The Bottom Line Reduce Cloud Costs by up to 75% Uniskai reduces your cloud expenses, allocating resources more efficiently. Maximize Cloud Efficiency Uniskai seamlessly integrates with major cloud providers, offering flexibility and ease of use. Every dollar managed and allocated Uniskai provides customized optimization approaches to match your specific needs. Reduce cloud waste by 90% Unlike other solutions, Uniskai operates agentless, simplifying deployment and management. Increase DevOps Productivity Uniskai's innovative features streamline workflows, saving you time and effort. With Uniskai we saved tens of percent on our cloud costs. What once required hours from the DevOps team now takes minutes — and as CTO, I can track everything with full transparency Amir Sturm CTO at Bizi Finance With Uniskai, we finally gained clarity and control over our chaotic cloud bills. The rightsizing feature helped us cut costs by nearly 30% — something we could never achieve before Asaf Bein Levy DevOps Engineer at Gliding Deer View Testimonial I’ve been trying to find an all-in-one solution to control cost allocation across our multi-account development environments for a long time. And, finally, we found Uniskai by Profisea Labs.
